mentions.name: RecurAt
mentions.description: RecurAt is a Next.js app hosted on Vercel that gives groups a simple way to know whether enough people show up for recurring activities, built around the need to confirm headcount for a weekly floorball game.
mentions.problem: A group playing floorball once a week needed a simple way to know they got enough players to play.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We’re a group playing floorball (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Floorball#:~:text=Floorball%20(also%20known%20by%20other,hollow%20plastic%20ball%20with%20holes.) once a week and needed a simple way to know we got enough players to play.

I’ve been mostly vibe coding RecurAt (https://recur.at) to get a feel for coding  this way and been learning a ton about frontend development at the same time.
